name: Boxes At Ref (BARF) - NG
teaser: Missed this mod? Well, I did too, so it's back! This mod adds lootboxes and other items from EFT:Arena to the new trader Ref.
description:
Updated version of Boxes At Ref (BARF) mod.

Original mod link: https://sp-mod.com/mod/1560/boxes-at-ref-barf 3.11 version link: https://sp-mod.com/mod/2128/boxes-at-ref-barf-again

Licensing: The original author has been inactive for a very long time and with the mod has MIT License I will maintain this mod for 4.0 until the author returns and take over should they wish to.

📂 Installation

Requirements

  • SPT 4.1.2++
  • Server mod only — no BepInEx plugin required

Steps

  1. Download the latest release
  2. Extract it into your SPT installation
  3. You should see:
SPT_Runtime/user/mods/BoxesAtRef/
    BoxesAtRef.dll
    database/

Restart your server and enjoy.

⚙️ Configuration

Configuration lives here:

SPT_Runtime/user/mods/BoxesAtRef/database/itemsToAdd.json
SPT_Runtime/user/mods/BoxesAtRef/database/crateContents.json

Editing the items:

1) Indivdual item

{
  "items": [
    {
      "_id": "crate_unique_id", // Don't touch
      "_tpl": "template_id", // Don't touch
      "openID": "open_animation_id", // Don't touch
      "price": 50,
      "buyRestrictionMax": 1,
      "loyaltyLevel": 1
    }
  ]
}

2) Crate contents

{
  "66573310a1657263d816a139": {
    "rewardCount": 3,
    "foundInRaid": true,
    "rewardTplPool": [] // Add MongoIds here
  }
}
